evidence.reason: Line 197 marks a line as inside a test body from the tracked defs after the same line's `def test_*` signature has already been tracked. A `def test_x(dep=pytest.importorskip("optional")):` signature is therefore treated as body, even though Python evaluates default arguments at definition time and the contract says `pytest.importorskip` flags only inside a visible `test*` function body. Signature expressions need to be tracked separately from actual body lines.
